ctx.x: Well, Rudy Toone(?). You'd know him if you ever see him, see a picture of him.

So Rudy Toones, he said, "Man, you got it made, boy." Mae West done went for you like a ton of bricks." So I waited and I went to her dressing room after, when she got through. So Miss Burgorne(?) said, "Miss West is ready to speak to you." So I went in the room. She said, "I've never noticed you on the show before." I said, "Well, I've been here, Miss West." She said, "Yeah. Well, I've got an extra part for you in the show. I wish you would consider it." I said, "Doing what?" She said, "Have you ever done any…
